#include <iostream>

#include <deque>

using namespace std;

typedef long long ll;

const ll INF = 1e18;

int main() {
    int N;
    cin >> N;
    const int M = 3;
    vector<int> A(M), B(M);
    for (int i = 0; i < M; ++i) cin >> A[i];
    for (int i = 0; i < M; ++i) cin >> B[i];

    ll ans1 = 0;
    for (int i = 0; i < M; ++i) {
        ans1 += min(A[i], B[(i + 1) % M]);
    }

    int n = 2 * M + 2;
    int s = 2 * M;
    int t = 2 * M + 1;
    vector<vector<ll>> cap(n, vector<ll>(n, 0));

    auto add_edge = [&](int u, int v, ll c) {
        cap[u][v] += c;
    };

    for (int i = 0; i < M; ++i) {
        add_edge(s, i, N);
        add_edge(M + i, t, B[i]);
        add_edge(i, M + i, A[i]);
        add_edge(i, M + (i - 1 + M) % M, A[i]);
    }

    ll flow = 0;
    vector<int> level(n);
    vector<int> it(n);

    while (true) {
        fill(level.begin(), level.end(), -1);
        level[s] = 0;
        deque<int> q;
        q.push_back(s);
        while (!q.empty()) {
            int v = q.front();
            q.pop_front();
            for (int to = 0; to < n; ++to) {
                if (cap[v][to] > 0 && level[to] < 0) {
                    level[to] = level[v] + 1;
                    q.push_back(to);
                }
            }
        }
        if (level[t] < 0) break;

        fill(it.begin(), it.end(), 0);

        function<ll(int, ll)> dfs = [&](int v, ll f) -> ll {
            if (v == t) return f;
            for (int &i = it[v]; i < n; ++i) {
                if (cap[v][i] == 0 || level[v] >= level[i]) continue;
                ll d = dfs(i, min(f, cap[v][i]));
                if (d == 0) continue;
                cap[v][i] -= d;
                cap[i][v] += d;
                return d;
            }
            return 0;
        };

        while (true) {
            ll f = dfs(s, INF);
            if (f == 0) break;
            flow += f;
        }
    }

    cout << N - flow << " " << ans1 << endl;

    return 0;
}
